gather_economic_intel.name: Gather Economic Intelligence
gather_economic_intel.description: Infiltrate economic ministries and corporations to assess industrial output, resource stockpiles, and upcoming projects.

success.description: Valuable economic data obtained.

failure.description: The operation failed to yield meaningful intelligence.

assess_military_readiness.name: Assess Military Readiness
assess_military_readiness.description: Monitor troop movements, training exercises, and supply depots to evaluate military preparedness.

success.description: Detailed assessment of enemy military readiness completed.

failure.description: Failed to gather reliable military intelligence.

sabotage_factory.name: Sabotage Industrial Production
sabotage_factory.description: Infiltrate key factories and delay or damage production lines.

success.description: Significant disruption to industrial output achieved.

failure.description: Sabotage attempt was unsuccessful.

disrupt_supply.name: Disrupt Supply Convoys
disrupt_supply.description: Target logistics networks and transportation infrastructure.

success.description: Enemy supply lines were successfully harassed.

failure.description: The operation was detected and neutralized.

boost_production.name: Optimize Industrial Production
boost_production.description: Use industrial expertise or influence to temporarily boost factory output, speed, or specific production categories (e.g., tanks, aircraft). Agent type/trait determines focus (e.g., tech specialist for armor, influence for general). Positive counterpart to sabotage.

success.description: Significant production efficiency gains achieved.

failure.description: The optimization efforts had little effect.

explore_resources.name: Resource Exploration & Prospecting
explore_resources.description: Deploy agents for geological surveys, prospecting, or acquiring resource maps/tech. Can discover new resource deposits, improve gathering efficiency, or reduce resource costs in production. Ties to resource gathering/exploration.

success.description: New resources prospected or extraction methods improved.

failure.description: Exploration yielded no significant results.

industrial_espionage.name: Acquire Industrial Secrets
industrial_espionage.description: Steal production techniques, blueprints, or efficiency methods from enemy industry. Boosts your production speed/output or unlocks better resource use. Positive industrial counterpart to tech theft.

success.description: Valuable production secrets acquired, boosting efficiency.

failure.description: The espionage attempt failed.

influence_propaganda.name: Run Influence Campaign
influence_propaganda.description: Spread propaganda and support opposition groups within the target nation.

success.description: Opposition movements gained significant traction.

failure.description: The influence operation had little effect.

corrupt_officials.name: Corrupt Key Officials
corrupt_officials.description: Bribe or compromise mid-to-high level government and military officials.

success.description: Valuable contacts established inside the target government.

failure.description: The corruption attempt was rebuffed or exposed.

steal_research.name: Steal Research Documents
steal_research.description: Infiltrate research laboratories and acquire technical documents.

success.description: Important technical documents were exfiltrated.

partial.description: Some useful research material was obtained.

failure.description: The technology theft operation failed.

infiltrate_research_lab.name: Infiltrate Research Facility
infiltrate_research_lab.description: Plant an agent inside a high-security research complex for long-term intelligence.

success.description: Agent successfully embedded in the research facility.

partial.description: Partial access to the facility was achieved.

failure.description: The infiltration attempt was detected.

counter_intel_sweep.name: Counter-Intelligence Sweep
counter_intel_sweep.description: Hunt for enemy agents and disrupt ongoing espionage operations in your own territory.

success.description: Several enemy networks were rolled up.

failure.description: The sweep turned up little of value.

double_agent_recruitment.name: Turn Enemy Agents
double_agent_recruitment.description: Identify and flip enemy operatives operating inside your borders.

success.description: Enemy intelligence networks suffered major setbacks.

partial.description: Limited success in turning hostile assets.

failure.description: The operation backfired and exposed friendly assets.

secure_research_facility.name: Harden Research Security
secure_research_facility.description: Tighten security around sensitive research programs to prevent technology theft.

success.description: Research facilities are now significantly harder to penetrate.

partial.description: Some improvements to research security were made.

failure.description: The security review was largely ineffective.

defend_tech_secrecy.name: Impose Project Secrecy (Manhattan-style)
defend_tech_secrecy.description: Assign a counter-intel specialist to tightly control a specific high-value research project or technology. Reduces enemy theft/sabotage chances significantly for the duration, at the cost of slower progress (compartmentalization) and high detection risk if the agent is targeted. Perfect for protecting breakthrough work like synthetic fuels, radar nets, or heavy armor programs.

success.description: Project security greatly enhanced; enemy operations against this tech heavily degraded for extended period.

failure.description: The secrecy effort failed or was compromised.

secure_inclusion.name: Secure Seat at the Peace Table
secure_inclusion.description: High-stakes operation to force or negotiate a seat for your nation (or allies) at the main conference table. Primary lever for Central Powers players seeking to rewrite history. Success generates major 'Inclusion Leverage'.

success.description: Major diplomatic breakthrough — your side gains real negotiating weight or forces observer/full participant status.

partial.description: Partial success. Some influence gained; the historical exclusion may be softened but not overturned.

failure.description: The attempt was exposed or rebuffed. Historical path hardens and grievance increases.

bribe_influential_minister.name: Bribe Key Negotiating Minister
bribe_influential_minister.description: Target a specific influential figure in an opposing or wavering delegation with direct financial or political inducements to shift their position on key terms.

success.description: The minister's voice moves in your favor on at least one major term bucket.

partial.description: Some movement; a minor concession or softened language is achieved.

failure.description: The approach failed or was quietly rejected. No change, minor prestige cost possible.

honeypot_operation.name: Honeypot / Compromise Operation
honeypot_operation.description: Deploy personal influence or a trusted operative to compromise or heavily sway a key Entente (or other) minister/delegate through seduction, scandal, or private leverage. High reward, high risk.

success.description: Target is now deeply compromised. Major shift available on one or more term buckets during resolution.

partial.description: Some useful leverage or embarrassing material obtained; partial term influence.

failure.description: Operation blown. Major scandal risk. Your own position weakened and historical gravity increases.

shape_public_narrative.name: Shape Public & Elite Narrative
shape_public_narrative.description: Run influence campaigns, plant stories, and sway elite opinion in target capitals (and your own) around 'fair peace' vs. 'harsh diktat' framing. Affects both conference resolution and later follow-on points.

success.description: Public and elite opinion moves noticeably in the desired direction. Grievance or winner legitimacy adjusted.

partial.description: Modest narrative gains. Small but real effect on resolution and future crises.

failure.description: Counter-narratives dominate. Little or no shift.

leak_negotiating_position.name: Leak Opposing Red Lines
leak_negotiating_position.description: Acquire and selectively leak the negotiating positions or bottom lines of other powers to create public pressure, bargaining advantage, or embarrassment.

success.description: Key positions exposed. You (or your side) gain meaningful leverage in the final resolution.

failure.description: No useful material or the leak backfired.

counter_conference_influence.name: Counter Enemy Conference Influence
counter_conference_influence.description: Active counter-intelligence and disruption against opposing agents and influence operations targeting the same ministers and delegations.

success.description: Enemy networks and influence attempts are rolled up or neutralized for the conference window.

failure.description: Counter-effort had little effect.

lobby_domestic_law.name: Lobby / Campaign for Policy or Law Change
lobby_domestic_law.description: Long-duration domestic influence operation: bribe parliamentarians, run propaganda campaigns, twist arms, plant stories, or directly influence a king/court to pass or block a major policy/law (pro-natal, borders, conscription, police type, money supply, justice, welfare/social services, etc.). Ties up the agent(s) for months — real trade-off vs Tech development, Intel, Trade, Vision (Initiatives), or Diplomacy work. Changing laws is a big deal; this is the primary lever for most players. Includes cultural war policies (elite 'healthcare' control vs traditional family).

success.description: Law or policy successfully shifted in the desired direction with reduced player cost or backlash. Agent commitment paid off.

partial.description: Modest progress — player change cost reduced or public opinion moved slightly.

failure.description: Effort exposed or blocked. Possible small backlash or wasted agent time.

expand_secret_police_network.name: Build or Expand Secret Police / Domestic Control Network
expand_secret_police_network.description: Agent-driven effort to grow secret police or internal control apparatus. Improves resistance to Hidden Hand subversion but risks public cohesion hit and 'tyranny' narrative if overdone.

success.description: Secret police apparatus strengthened. Better Hidden Hand defense, public trust cost.

failure.description: Network compromised or public backlash.

fund_secret_space_program.name: Fund / Launder for Secret Space Program
fund_secret_space_program.description: Use black market, front companies, or influence ops to channel hidden funds into secret space/rocket projects. Requires or boosts 'secret_funding' tech path. Low visibility but high reward for covert space race.

success.description: Black funds successfully laundered into the secret space effort. Accelerates hidden rocket/sat progress.

partial.description: Partial funding secured; some progress on clandestine assets.

failure.description: Funding attempt exposed or diverted. Minor scandal risk if secret_funding active.

steal_space_intel.name: Steal Enemy Space Program Intel
steal_space_intel.description: Target rival's public or secret space efforts for blueprints, sat imagery, or rocket tech. Synergizes with v2_rocket / sputnik tech trees.

success.description: Valuable space tech documents and telemetry obtained.

partial.description: Fragmentary data on enemy orbital or rocket programs.

failure.description: Space intel op failed or backfired.

pre_battle_sabotage.name: Pre-Battle Sabotage & Intel
pre_battle_sabotage.description: Infiltrate enemy depots, rails, and command pre-offensive to degrade readiness, fort effectiveness, and org (directly feeds battle preview and combat power).

success.description: Significant pre-battle disruption: defender fort/readiness reduced in preview and opening combat.

partial.description: Partial sabotage achieved; modest impact on enemy combat staying power.

failure.description: Sabotage network compromised or ineffective.

july_crisis_infiltrate.name: Infiltrate July Crisis (1914)
july_crisis_infiltrate.description: 1910-era special: manipulate SER/AUH/RUS/GER/ENG/FRA decision-makers or leak intel during the July Crisis to tilt avert/limited/escalated outcome (ripples to 1918 peace_state and OOB mods).

success.description: De-escalation or favorable intel leak: raises chance of averted/limited path (better 1918 start for player side).

partial.description: Some influence applied to crisis participants.

failure.description: Crisis manipulation exposed; may worsen escalation for your side.

balkan_league_intel.name: Balkan League Intelligence
balkan_league_intel.description: 1910-era: penetrate Balkan League vs Ottoman networks (1912-13) to shape intervention odds and alt border outcomes (affects 1918 grievances/leverage via 1912_balkan_alt flag).

success.description: Key intel or agent pressure alters Balkan War path (flag set for 1918 ripple).

failure.description: Balkan networks remain opaque.
